newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korean diplomat killed in Russia.
newsitem.headline: South Korean diplomat killed in Russia.

text.p: South Korea's Consul General in Russia's Far East city of Vladivostok was found dead near his apartment on Tuesday in an apparent murder, a foreign minstry spokesman said on Wednesday.
"There were marks that showed he was hit over the head," the spokesman said.
Later, a foreign ministry statement said Choi Duck-keun had been attacked on the stairs of his apartment.
"Consul general Choi was attacked by unidentified men on the stairs of his residence and he was killed on the spot," the statement quoted chief foreign ministry spokesman Suh Dae-won as saying.
"Choi seems to have been killed by blows to the head," Suh said. His wallet, passport, cash and other personal belongings remained untouched.
Russian police have launched an investigation, the statement added.
